title: Hermitian–Yang–Mills dynamics and harmonic moduli near a conifold

abstract_html: We construct a nonflat rank-four bundle family on compact Calabi–Yau threefolds smoothing eight ordinary double points and compare its Hermitian–Einstein metrics, metric flow and local moduli geometry uniformly through degeneration. A two-arrow matrix form determines all seven small trace-free endomorphism eigenvalues with relative error, including changing kernels and arbitrarily separated positive rates. On each polystable member, an open spatial C1 basin admits a finite invariant graph and an initial phase for which the actual Hermitian–Yang–Mills flow tracks an exact graph trajectory with exponentially decaying C1 error for all time. At the Hermitian–Einstein equilibrium, the Hessian of twice Donaldson's functional restricted to the graph is relatively equivalent to the same matrix form in the original metric coordinates. We also identify the actual local bundle classes and compare their harmonic metric on every stabilizer stratum. For paths confined to this locus, the unique metric tangent cone at the split bundle is (C2,4|du|2)/((Z/2)2⋊S2). All comparisons allow independent node and bundle scales.
